name: Guard
description: Semantic authorization adapter for OpenClaw using Guard sidecar.

endpoint.description: Guard sidecar HTTP endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:4517.

timeoutMs.description: Decision request timeout in milliseconds. Default: 5000.

mode.description: Operating mode. observe logs but allows; enforce blocks violations.

failurePolicy.description: Behavior when Guard sidecar is unreachable. Default: fail_open.

credentialFile.description: Non-secret path to the Guard/OpenClaw runtime credential handoff file. Defaults to ~/.config/guard/runtime/openclaw-client.json.
